title: Rating Rule Card: Collision Reports of a Driver Whose Owner Auto Policy Exclusion Is Lifted
content:
**Accident relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, an accident relativity multiplies the lift share of a driver whose named driver exclusion is lifted on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The relativity counts the claim reports of the term, on the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) claim file, that name the driver as operator with a collision cause: a collision with another vehicle, or a single-vehicle collision.

| Such claim reports | Relativity |
|---|---|
| two or more | 1.45 |
| one | 1.25 |
| none | 1 |

**Hypothetical readings.**
- A driver named on one collision-with-vehicle report while excluded, and on one single-vehicle collision report from earlier in the term, has two such reports: 1.45.
- A driver named only on a theft report has none: 1.
